luiskr.com / core/firebase / signInWithGoogle

function signInWithGoogle(): Promise<void | UserCredential>;

Defined in: core/firebase.ts:120

CMS login — Google OAuth popup. prompt: 'select_account' forces the account chooser so a CMS editor isn't silently signed into a wrong Google account. When the environment can't complete the popup handshake (popup blockers, COOP window.closed blocking, partitioned web storage, unsupported contexts — the AUTH_REDIRECT_FALLBACK_CODES set), retries transparently via signInWithRedirect, which navigates away and never resolves.

Returns

Promise<void | UserCredential>

The SDK UserCredential, or nothing when the redirect fallback fires.
